caption: The drawing features two views of ceramic vessels in a sepia or light brown color. On the left is a pitcher, measuring 10.5 inches in height and 8 inches in width at its widest point; the handle is shaped somewhat like an animal, possibly with a creature’s face at the top. Decorative relief motifs on the pitcher include a band of grapevines and bunches of grapes near the top and a scene lower on the body showing dogs chasing a stag among foliage. On the right is a separate view of a vessel side, showing a close-up of a portion of the design, which features a reclining animal under a leafy tree. The composition provides detailed linear measurements and highlights the vessel's decorative elements. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a handwritten label in the upper right, along with the name “M. H. McDowell” at the bottom right of the right view.
title: Pitcher
